title: Nice selection of shapes - FYI: sharpness on cutting edge
text: Nice selection of shapes - FYI: sharpness on cutting edge. Happy with this selection of shapes. FYI the cutting edge surprised me. Would not let kids use these without education first. Make a lot of cookies and don't recall needed such an edge to cut, but because they're simply metal, it is the nature of the material. Cleaned easily by hand. Would not try in dishwasher.
